name: Saw this and thought of you
title: Saw this and thought of you
note: 1 photo, no redraw; hook rendered at bottom because her head reaches the top quarter
caption:
Saw this and thought of you. Send it to the one who came to mind.

This one is about the kind of peace that holds steady when your mind keeps racing. It does not come from having everything figured out, it comes from trusting the One who does.

Isaiah 26:3 (BSB)

Save it for a day you need it.
